title: StreetComplete on iOS is now in public beta
summary: StreetComplete, a popular OpenStreetMap crowdsourcing app, has launched its iOS public beta, allowing iPhone users to contribute to open-source mapping by answering location-based questions about their surroundings, expanding its accessibility beyond Android.
problem_solved: Enables iOS users to easily contribute accurate geographic data to OpenStreetMap by answering simple questions about nearby places.
why_valuable: Expands the contributor base for OpenStreetMap to iOS users, improving global open-source mapping data quality and coverage.
